purpose: Document the TASK_049 polling interpretation so future rounds do not misread a healthy early-training run as 'diverging'.
single_variable_change_vs_baseline: DATA ONLY (fixed expert, unfrozen left knee, sha256 a115209b). Config/algorithm/rewards/eval-harness UNCHANGED from TASK_20260727_024 baseline (commit 3064f7d).
interpretation_method: Used `gm task data get --sampling-mode precise` (reads full tfevents metrics) because the `gm task logs` API returns a TRUNCATED/buffered view (only ~first 5KB / early iters) for this task, unlike iteration 4 where logs scrolled fully.

calibration_vs_healthy_baseline.finding: TASK_049 at iter ~101 is HEALTHY and on-track with the TASK_024 baseline, NOT diverging.
calibration_vs_healthy_baseline.evidence:
At matched early iterations TASK_049 vs TASK_024 are nearly identical:
  - episode_length iter3-7: TASK_049 [93,120,144,166,174] vs TASK_024 [93,120,144,166,175] (identical).
  - AMP/style_reward decay: TASK_049 (0.9477@0 -> 0.3999@39) vs TASK_024 (0.9516@0 -> 0.3999@39) IDENTICAL. This decay is NORMAL AMP behavior (style reward high at init when disc is untrained, settles as disc learns to distinguish). It is NOT a divergence.
  - tracking_lin_vel early: TASK_049 ~0.09 vs TASK_024 ~0.04-0.06 (TASK_049 slightly HIGHER, not worse).
calibration_vs_healthy_baseline.what_was_initially_misread: Mean_reward=13.6/0.81 and ep_len=171 were transient single-iter noise seen at the chart edge, plus the log was truncated. The 'style_reward -> 0' is the normal settling curve, not a collapse. ep_len ~150-233 at iter<100 is the normal early-training regime (TASK_024 ep_len at iter3 was also 93).
calibration_vs_healthy_baseline.caution_for_future_polls: Do NOT interpret low ep_len / decaying style_reward / low tracking at iter<300 as failure — these match the healthy baseline. Compare against TASK_024 at the SAME iteration index, not against TASK_024's FINAL converged values. The judgment point is iter>=1500: a healthy run reaches tracking_lin_vel>=0.8, ep_len>=1500, terrain_level>3 by then.

training_pace: iter 101 reached at poll time (~14:30). Pod spent ~70min in queue/setup (startTime 12:02 but log_dir created 12:05; the gap is SDK/import init). Iteration speed itself normal (Perf/total_fps~51000, ~1.4s/iter). Training to 2000 will take ~47min of compute from iter-start; eval ~10min after.
